tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi rū pa'i srung ba thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs// ༈ /rdo rje 'chang dang grub chen bi rū pa// kun dga' snying po rtse mo grags rgyal mtshan// sa skya paṇa chen tshogs sgom gnyan chen par// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// brag phug pa dang bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs// dpal ldan tshul khrims grub chen bud+dha shrī// ngor chen kun dga' bzang po sems dpa' cher// gsol ba= /blo gros rgyal mtshan rje btsun rdo ring pa// blo gsal rgya mtsho 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang*// bslab gsum rgyal mtshan dbang phyug rab brtan la// gsol ba= /bsod nams mchog ldan mkhan chen zhwa lu pa// mkhyen rab byams pa kun dga' lhun grub dang*// kun dga' legs 'byung blo gsal phun tshogs zhabs// gsol ba= /khri chen kun mkhyen rig 'dzin maṅga'i mtshan// bstan 'dzin snyan grags rin chen mkhyen brtse'i dbang*//

bka' drin mnyam med kun dga' bstan 'dzin rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba= /bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras dang bcas// kun 'dus bdag nyid dpal ldan bir+wa pas// skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs rjes bzung nas// tshul khrims gsum ldan dge ba'i bshes byin rlobs// phyi nang rig pa'i gzhung lugs rab 'byams kyi// thos bsam bsgom pa gegs med mthar phyin nas// rgyal ba'i yon tan kun la dbang 'byor zhing*// bstan dang sems can phan pa bsgrub par shog / ces rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi rū pa'i srung ba thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs kyis brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di ni dge slong kun dga' stobs ldan gyis bskul ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// zhal bskong blo gros rgyal mtshan nam gzim 'og a nan+tas bris// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
